newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat in quiet start to week.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat in quiet start to week.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly unchanged on Monday, traders said.

Gas oil outright prices were 25 cents firmer in line with the August IPE contract, trading at $167.75. Business was inactive. Spreads were stable with 0.2 percent sulphur barges notionally assessed at August IPE +$0.50.
Fuel oil markets were stable and quiet, with high sulphur barges trading at $91 a tonne amid weak bunker demand.
Gasoline was steady to narrowly firmer with eurograde material pegged around $200-201.00 fob. Demand was slim, as were supplies.
